Peppermint (Mentha Piperita)

Remedy peppermint digestive antispasmodic ibc nausea

Evidence: peer_reviewed

Summary

Cooling mint herb with antispasmodic properties; relieves digestive discomfort, IBS symptoms, and nausea.

Indications

  • irritable bowel syndrome
  • digestive discomfort
  • nausea
  • muscle pain
  • headache

Contraindications

  • GERD (may worsen reflux)
  • children under 6

Preparations

  • oil
  • tea
  • tincture
  • capsule

Body Systems Affected

  • digestive
  • nervous
  • musculoskeletal

Treats These Ailments

Conditions listed as treatable by this remedy:

  • Irritable Bowel Syndrome
    Functional gastrointestinal disorder characterized by abdominal pain, bloating, and altered bowel habits (diarrhea or constipation).

Sources

  • https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3198144/ (PMC - Peppermint for IBS)
